**Conversation Overview**

This conversation was a working session of an ongoing long-form technical project called "The Method 1.6," a multi-volume structured document system with a precise versioning and build protocol. The session operated under a governing document called HANDOFF-39, which specified a reading gate (§0) that must be executed before any other action. The person is the author of this project; Claude served as the executing agent performing all file operations, measurements, and edits according to a strict set of standing rulings (1–60 plus a R27 Amendment) and session-specific gate conditions (G0 through G0i).

The session's sole completed task was building and closing SPEC-11: a defect repair in the Spectra Compendium volume. The defect had been recorded as a single sentence at Spectra L990, but re-testing from the file (per gate G0b, which requires defects to be re-tested rather than inherited from their disposition lines) revealed a four-line block with three distinct disorientation clauses, not one. The repair replaced the entire lead-in with corrected text carrying no count figure by design, preventing recurrence. Main L10178 was re-tested and confirmed correct. Register entry 1783 was written recording the change, citation figures were driven and verified, the load-bearing citation table was updated (entry 1578 recounted 8× → 9×), and all 162 press anchor pairs in build.py were re-asserted after front-matter edits broke two of them. A new gate condition G0i was established based on a discovery this session: an unmoved citation figure (1578 staying at 8×) revealed that the entry had used "Entries N" rather than "Registers N," which the instrument register_cites.py cannot parse. The Register encodes a real distinction — "Registers N" cites and is counted, "entries N" merely names and is not. BUILD-39 was packed (2 + 103 = 105 members), verified byte-exact in both directions against a pristine split, and HANDOFF-40 was written into the tree and presented. The session closed at an estimated 78–82% context, below the 90% handoff threshold, but with a complete handoff already packed, making further work inadvisable because it would require repacking both bundles.

Key patterns demonstrated across this session include: never changing an instrument to resolve a discrepancy (G0c), re-running all sweeps after any front-matter edit (G0g), deleting `__pycache__` on its own line before every pack (G0e), asserting anchors at both ends before edits (G0f), and withdrawing a false mid-session claim (about the colophon's Build 9 and register_gen.py reaching a reader) explicitly in the session record rather than leaving it standing. The person's project maintains a strict discipline of measuring all figures from files rather than reciting them, and of recording corrections and lessons in the working register and handoff documents for continuity across sessions.
